The 3D maritime LMS for seafarers

The transition to advanced learning at sea.

ShipLearn brings marine and safety training into realistic 3D vessels. Seafarers practise on board or ashore, and ship managers see who is competent, on which ship, at any time.

01 / Marine and safety training

Knowledge, skills and confidence for every seafarer, so they operate safely, efficiently and in line with international maritime regulations.

It builds a strong safety culture on board, sharpens how crews recognise and manage risk, and connects what happens on the vessel with the people who manage it ashore.

A

Safety culture on board

Crews practise the right response until it becomes habit, not a box ticked once a contract.

B

Risk awareness

Realistic hazards teach seafarers to spot risk early and make sound decisions under pressure.

C

Confidence in a real emergency

Repeating a realistic drill builds calm, quick responses, so crews know what to do when the alarm is real.

02 / 3D ship and vessel simulations

Six simulations, one realistic vessel.

Each simulation runs in the browser, in VR or in a training centre, and every decision is scored and saved to the seafarer’s record.

    Start simulation →View details
    03 / Transition to advanced learning

    From classroom theory to hands-on competence.

    Step 01

    Learn

    Short e-learning lessons cover the theory, procedures and regulations behind each task.

    Step 02

    Practise in 3D

    Seafarers carry out the task on a realistic 3D vessel, with real equipment, alarms and consequences.

    Step 03

    Assess

    Every step is timed and checked against the correct procedure, with a debrief on what to improve.

    Step 04

    Record competence

    Results sync from vessel to shore, building a record ready for audits and crew planning.

    04 / On the vessel

    Training that works mid-voyage.

    1. Self-paced courses and 3D simulations for every rank
    2. Onboard drills run by officers, recorded automatically
    05 / Ashore

    Oversight for ship managers.

    1. Competence matrix by vessel, rank and seafarer
    2. Assign training ahead of crew changes and inspections
    3. Audit-ready records that connect with your crewing and ship management systems
    06 / Who it’s for

    Built for everyone who keeps ships safe.

    Shore control view
    07 / Platform

    Everything a maritime LMS should do.

    Courses

    E-learning, video and assessments alongside the 3D simulations, in one record per seafarer.

    Assigning

    By vessel, rank, crewing agency or crew change.

    Offline

    Download at port, train mid-voyage, sync later.

    Certificates

    Expiry dates tracked, with reminders before they lapse.

    Devices

    Browser, VR headset or full-mission classroom.

    Languages and integration

    Voices and subtitles in your crews’ languages, with SCORM and links into crewing and ship management software.
